card.name: Inside German-style surnames after Sch
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a proper name or foreign word, usually right after Sch, St or Sh. Mostly German or Dutch surnames and place names, such as Schneier, Scheel, Schimmel and Schmemann.

modes.label: Surnames after Sch
modes.description: Letters continuing a German surname that begins with Sch.

modes.label: Other name starts
modes.description: Continuation of a Dutch or other surname or a Latin organism name starting with St or Sh.

modes.label: German common words
modes.description: Middle of a German noun or place name.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of German-looking surnames and words, just after the opening letters Sch.
